predictions: P-A (Ep track, TRACKING not HTS): the fresh blind Ep(t) RISES then falls. Concretely - first constrained block Ep in 95-160 keV; a maximum of Ep = 180-210 keV (nuFnu-peak frame, CPL or Band) located in the 11.7-14.7 s interval, coincident with Lu+2018's FRED peak tm = 12.70 +- 0.10 s; then a decline to 100-130 keV by ~20 s and <=130 keV in any block past 27 s. FALSIFIER: a monotonic hard-to-soft track with the maximum in the FIRST block would contradict Lu+2018 (class T, tracking), Yu+2019 ('flat to h.t.s.') and the Lu FRED peak simultaneously, and must be reported as a three-way conflict rather than smoothed away. Frame note: Band Ep runs ~15-25% BELOW CPL Ep in the same block in Yu+2019 - compare like with like.

P-B (BB / union rule): the L18+ engine reproduces at least ONE union-rule BB block inside the 6.6-19.2 s core - most probably the blk-2-equivalent [6.6,9.7] s - and the blk-4-equivalent [12.1,14.7] s BB stays BASELINE-DEPENDENT (fires against CPL, not against Band). FALSIFIER A: a fresh union tally of 0 over the whole burst means the archival 3-block count was a pre-L18 seed/cap artifact (L8/L9 class) and the P3 diff must say so. FALSIFIER B: >4 union blocks would exceed both archival eras and must be checked against the kT-instability warning before being believed. Note that the literature is COMPLETELY silent on a thermal component here (Yu+2019 fit CPL and Band only; Lu+2018 Band only) - there is no external prior in either direction, so this prediction is graded against our own two archival eras alone.

P-C (break structure): blk6's LRT_DSBPL_SBPL = 9.87 plus two SBPLfree AIC wins predict at least one VALID SBPL/SBPLfree/DSBPL block in the fresh run, located in 12-19 s. FALSIFIER: zero valid break blocks anywhere falsifies the archival break signal as engine-era artifact. Watch the collision explicitly: in blk6 the BB and the break are competing to explain the same curvature.

P-D (low-energy index, no line-of-death violation): in every constrained block the blind alpha lands in [-1.45, -0.75]; Yu+2019's seven S>=20 blocks give -1.38..-0.81 and Lu+2018's nine bins -1.57..-0.99. FALSIFIER: alpha > -2/3 in a well-constrained high-significance block would contradict both published sets and should be treated as an engine or response problem first, physics second.

P-E (coverage / late blocks): fresh blocking over the full stamped window [-3.945, 39.525] produces at least one block beyond +30.4 s (the archival span's end) that the archival prior cannot be diffed against; its Ep should be <=130 keV and its significance low (Lu+2018's 27.14-40.83 s bin has F = 1.4e-7 erg/s/cm2; Yu+2019's 31.63-40.00 s block has S = 3.46). FALSIFIER: a HIGH-significance late block would mean our source window (or the b1 background that starts at +32.49 s) is mis-placed.
